title: Left exact profinite fundamental groups and algebraic base change for commutative pro-algebraic groups over perfect fields
author: Michel Brion
work: On the fundamental groups of commutative algebraic groups
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.25
difficulty_reason: The author constructs derived profinite homotopy functors through colocalizing pro-artinian categories, identifies universal extensions and vanishing higher homotopy via affine and abelian-variety structure, and proves algebraic separable base-change compatibility by an explicit Weil-restriction lifting argument. This categorical algebraic-group construction goes beyond ordinary qualifying examinations.
